{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Capex will be anywhere between 3% to 5% of sales for FY26",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "our capex will be anywhere between 3% to 5% of sales.",
      "outcome": "Capex spend figures were not explicitly provided in the financial statements or call reports.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Annual Financials Mar 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "EBITDA margins corridor of 20% to 24% for FY26",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "We stay committed to our corridor of 20% to 24%. As you saw in first half, we are at the higher end of that corridor",
      "outcome": "Full year FY26 OPM reached 24.0% (Mar 2026 annual financials), hitting the upper end of the guided range.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Annual Financials Mar 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "A&SP expenses maintained in the band of 3% to 5%",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "our A&SP will be in the band of 3% to 5%.",
      "outcome": "A&SP percentage reported at 4.2% in Q2 FY26, well within the 3% to 5% band.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2025 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "EBITDA margin corridor of 20% to 24% in medium term",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "the EBITDA corridor which we have shared is 20% to 24%.",
      "outcome": "OPM was 23.0% in Mar 2026, 26.0% in Jun 2026, and 20.0% in Sep 2026.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly Financials Mar 2026 - Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Deliver EBITDA margin of 20% to 24% in H2 FY27",
      "made_in": "Nov 2026",
      "quote": "remain very confident of Q3 and quite confident of the full second half that we should be able to deliver in our EBITDA margin corridor of 20% to 24%",
      "outcome": "H2 FY27 results (Dec 2026 / Mar 2027) are not yet available in reported financials.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2026 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "UVG growth should remain double digit in medium term",
      "made_in": "Nov 2026",
      "quote": "If the country's growth is in the 6.5, 7 range in real terms, our UVG growth should remain double digit and we would like to keep inching it up",
      "outcome": "H1 FY27 Underlying Volume Growth (UVG) was reported at 11%, achieving double-digit growth.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2026 call reported metrics"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 4,
    "partly": 0,
    "missed": 0,
    "summary": "Management consistently meets or exceeds its margin and volume growth promises, adhering closely to its guided 20%-24% EBITDA corridor."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "Margin guidance of 20%-24% aligns closely with actual quarterly OPM numbers ranging between 20% and 26%.",
    "Management narrative of double-digit volume momentum is supported by reported 11% H1 FY27 UVG.",
    "Reported FY26 revenue growth of 11.1% supports the medium-term top-line growth confidence voiced by management."
  ]
}
